controls.repeat: the same HF run repeated (repeat 1 against repeat 0)

implementation.linear: tokens, output features and input features each split into 3 chunks; input-feature partials summed in reverse order in FP32

controls.rule: same-precision bounds: 4 * max(repeat, implementation control) + floor; cross-precision bounds: 4 * max(BF16 repeat 0, BF16 implementation control against FP32 repeat 0) + floor
